articles.title: America's air traffic control meltdown: How US flight crisis unfolded & what next
articles.description: On November 13, a significant communications failure caused a nationwide ground stop for US flights. Airports experienced delays, cancellations, and diversions, affecting approximately 1.5 million passengers. The Federal Aviation Administration identified outdated equipment as the primary cause for the disruption and enforced departure restrictions for safety. Following the incident, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy requested $50 billion in emergency funding for infrastructure modernization.

articles.title: Sheikh Hasina's return to Bangladesh: India wants Dhaka to fulfil two conditions
articles.description: India is reportedly seeking Sheikh Hasina’s return to Bangladesh after more than two years in exile, but has set two conditions for Tarique Rahman’s government. According to BBC Bangla, New Delhi wants the Bangladesh army to fly Hasina back and guarantee her an opportunity to appeal her death sentence and face a fresh trial over the July 2024 crackdown.

articles.title: Jensen Huang's Nvidia exit costs him Rs 900 crore: How much wealth does he have left?
articles.description: Jensen Huang is expected to lose around $108 million in unvested stock awards following his exit from Nvidia. His net worth, primarily composed of Nvidia shares, is around $144.5 billion. Huang's holdings include approximately 812 million shares, valued at about $135 billion. Despite this wealth, he has sold around $3 billion in stock since Nvidia's IPO in 1999. Potential legal investigations may impact Huang's ability to sell shares in the future.

articles.title: 'Sandiyar' title row: Krishnasamy issues fresh warning to Kamal Haasan
articles.description: Kamal Haasan's much-anticipated film 'Sandiyar' is facing backlash from politician K. Krishnasamy, who demands a change to the title within a week. He warns of protests if his deadline is disregarded, citing concerns that the title could spark community unrest in Tamil Nadu. Notably, Krishnasamy had similarly protested a movie with the same name twenty years ago, leading to a title alteration.
